notablePrerequisites: One of your opponents controls a creature.
description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping itself and King Macar, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling any creature an opponent controls and creating a Gold token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Gold token and King Macar, targeting King Macar.
Holding priority, activate the Gold token by sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing target noncreature permanent an opponent controls to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping King Macar.
Repeat from step 2.
